record.paper_title: Billiard Dynamics: A Survey with the Emphasis on Open Problems
record.original_question: Construct a planar billiard table with positive entropy in either of the following regularity classes: (a) a strictly convex table whose boundary is C1-smooth, or (b) a convex table whose boundary is C2-smooth.

evidence.quote: By the (metric) entropy of a billiard we mean the entropy of the Liouville measure.
Problem 2. a) Construct a strictly convex C1-smooth billiard table with positive entropy. b) Construct a convex C2-smooth billiard table with positive entropy.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider planar billiards: given a bounded planar domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ with sufficiently regular boundary $\partial\Omega$, the billiard flow describes the free motion of a point particle inside $\Omega$ that reflects elastically (angle of incidence equals angle of reflection) upon reaching $\partial\Omega$. The associated billiard map acts on the unit tangent bundle restricted to $\partial\Omega$ and preserves the Liouville (canonical) invariant measure. The metric entropy of the billiard is defined as the Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy of the billiard map with respect to this Liouville measure.

Solve either of the following:

(a) Exhibit an explicit example of a strictly convex planar domain $\Omega$ whose boundary $\partial\Omega$ is of class $C^1$ such that the associated billiard has positive metric entropy.

(b) Exhibit an explicit example of a convex planar domain $\Omega$ whose boundary $\partial\Omega$ is of class $C^2$ such that the associated billiard has positive metric entropy.

(Recall that the Bunimovich stadium has $C^1$ but not strictly convex boundary, and is not $C^2$, so it does not qualify for either part.)
artifact.status_search_result: No explicit construction of either a strictly convex C^1 or a convex C^2 billiard table with positive metric (Liouville) entropy is known. Recent work (Bertelegne–Crovisier–Lazrag, 2022/2024) establishes that a C^2-generic convex body has positive *topological* entropy, but this is not a concrete construction and does not address positive metric entropy. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy
status_evidence.snippet: There exists a C^2 open dense set of convex bodies with smooth boundary whose billiard map has a non-trivial hyperbolic basic set, hence positive topological entropy.
status_evidence.claim: Generic C^2 convex billiards have positive topological entropy, but explicit constructions with positive metric entropy are not provided.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems concerning entropy of convex billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Construction of convex C^2 (or strictly convex C^1) billiards with positive entropy is still listed among open problems.
